title: A collective open letter to Mark Zuckerberg from the IFCN Arabic Coalition
snippet: 七個 MENA 查核組織的區域性聯名信（AkhbarMeter、Beam Reports、Fatabyyano、Kashif、Maharat Foundation、Tech4Peace、Verify-Sy）；無台灣組織。
collection_note: 用途＝區辨『主聯名信 vs 區域信』，防簽署名單張冠李戴。低權重背景。
gate_reason: Out of scope (geography): this is the IFCN Arabic Coalition's regional letter (7 MENA orgs -- AkhbarMeter, Beam Reports, Fatabyyano, Kashif, Maharat Foundation, Tech4Peace, Verify-Sy), zero Taiwan signatories, and does not serve Q2/Q3's US/EU-mechanism-and-defunding narrative; brief Scope explicitly excludes cross-national comparative research. Kept out of accepted.jsonl but recorded here precisely so its disambiguation function survives: do not confuse with the main global 2025-01 IFCN letter (c007), which IS in scope and does carry Taiwan signatories.

title: Reuters Institute — Amid war, vicious attacks and political turmoil, global fact-checkers fear the impact of the end of Meta's programme
snippet: 多國查核組織訪談：Chequeado 已多元化至 Meta 僅佔營收 10%（Google/TikTok/civic-tech 工具/素養專案）；Aos Fatos 靠內容授權＋會員制＋技術與情報服務；部分組織為 Meta 計畫而生、撤資即滅頂——曝險光譜兩端並陳。
collection_note: C 幕『多元化倖存策略』國際對照組（供台灣線定位，不展開跨國比較）。MyGoPen 的授權＋教育轉身與 Aos Fatos 同構。
gate_reason: Out of scope: substantive content is a cross-national comparison of Global South orgs' diversification strategies (Chequeado/Argentina at ~10% Meta-revenue exposure, Aos Fatos/Brazil licensing+membership model) -- exactly the axis brief Scope excludes ('不做跨國比較研究'), and risks the same scope-creep the brief explicitly warns against for D, here applied to C. Its secondary B-content (global fear of program end) duplicates c010/c012/c015 without added Taiwan-service value. Operator note: if the Drafter later wants exactly one international-comparison sentence to texture the C leverage argument (not a comparative section), this is the record to pull back in -- flagging rather than silently dropping.
